Change c0268. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. XIV.

Context before (unchanged): "They found a miserable asylum in the cottage in Germany, where I discovered them.

1818 text: Felix soon learned that the treacherous Turk, for whom he and his family endured such unheard-of oppression, on discovering that his deliverer was thus reduced to poverty and impotence, became a traitor to good feeling and honour, and had quitted Italy with his daughter, insultingly sending Felix a pittance of money to aid him, as he said, in some plan of future maintenance.

1831 text: Felix soon learned that the treacherous Turk, for whom he and his family endured such unheard-of oppression, on discovering that his deliverer was thus reduced to poverty and ruin, became a traitor to good feeling and honour, and had quitted Italy with his daughter, insultingly sending Felix a pittance of money, to aid him, as he said, in some plan of future maintenance.

Diff: Felix soon learned that the treacherous Turk, for whom he and his family endured such unheard-of oppression, on discovering that his deliverer was thus reduced to poverty and [-impotence-] {+ruin+} , became a traitor to good feeling and honour, and had quitted Italy with his daughter, insultingly sending Felix a pittance of money {+,+} to aid him, as he said, in some plan of future maintenance.

Context after (unchanged): "Such were the events that preyed on the heart of Felix, and rendered him, when I first saw him, the most miserable of his family.

result.rationale: Replaces 'impotence' with 'ruin' in describing the Turk's deliverer's reduced state, a shift from helplessness toward material/social collapse; plus a comma insertion. Stylistic word choice keeping the same event and meaning.
